getFileDownloadPathPattern.description:
Container - Every Product Version can have multiple containers e.g. BIG-IP -> "BIG-IP v16.x" have containers like "ServerTechnologiesUpdates", "GeoLocationUpdates_Puls" etc.

Version First - Every Product Version will only have one container e.g. NGINX -> "NGINX Service Mesh" has only one container "NGINX_Service_Mesh"

Distribution First - container value should be split with "-" to get
Linux Distribution
Distribution Version
Architecture

e.g. NGINX -> "NGINX App Protect" has conatiner value "alpine-3.10-x86_64" from which
Linux Distribution is "alpine"
Distribution Version is "3.10"
Architecture is "x86_64"
